displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is d and digit 1 is 3. The code is d3
meaning: Configuration mismatch. The air conditioner or heat pump fails to operate.
causes: Shared data sent to the integrated control module does not match the hardware configuration
diySteps: Write down d3 before power is turned off
Technician: verify communicating or legacy wiring, confirm the shared data matches this model, and re-populate it if required. The chart also allows wiring the system as a legacy system
Technician: use Bluetooth Shared Data Loader BTSDL01 with power off before it is inserted and before it is removed
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. d3 is shared data that does not match the hardware.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
